title: Request: Video Tutorial For Adding Steam Achievements

posts.author: BrysonUltra
posts.body:
Would anyone be willing to create a video tutorial for how to add Steam Achievements to a game made with VX Ace?
I'm sure other users here would also appreciate a video tutorial to avoid making sloppy mistakes.

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body:
Did you google it?
I searched for "rpg maker vx ace steam achievements" and found
this video
that appears to outline the process.
This thread
also came up, which includes pretty straightforward instructions and even a FAQ.
If neither the video nor the thread cover your issue, I'd suggest you describe what you're stuck on, because a bespoke video is a pretty big ask. You're likely to get more help if you directly state your problem and why the existing resources didn't help.
